{{move|Billy}} [[File:Billy JN098.png|thumb|250px|Billy]] '''Billy''' (Japanese: '''ビリー''' ''Billy'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN098|Out of Their Elements!]]''. Billy is a circus performer specializing in {{t|Electric}} types. Billy was first seen practicing a performance alongside his {{p|Eevee}} [[nickname]]d Toril, which he planned to [[Evolution|evolve]] into a {{p|Jolteon}} during the next performance. While talking to {{Ash}}, [[Goh]], and [[Chloe]], a [[Fire Stone]] was accidentally dropped on his Eevee, causing him to evolve into {{p|Flareon}}. {{OBP|Harmony|JN098}}'s Eevee accidentally became a Jolteon, so Billy took her instead, but she refused to listen to his commands. While practicing with his other Pokémon, Toril showed off his {{m|Ember}} and Billy was able to come up with a plan which involved Harmony and [[Chloe's Eevee]] to do a performance. After their performance, Billy provided Chloe with a [[Thunder Stone]] so that Chloe could evolve her Eevee into a Jolteon one day. He reappeared in a flashback in ''[[JN120|Infinite Possibilities!]]''. In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Billy reappeared in a fantasy, alongside other Trainers Chloe and her Eevee met. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Toril |trainer=Billy |pkmn=Flareon |gender=male |type1=Fire |img=Billy Toril Eevee.png |img2=Billy Toril.png |epnum=JN098 |epname=Out of Their Elements! |vajp=Haruka Shamoto |vajpnote=Flareon |vaen= |desc='''Toril''' (Japanese: '''ライム''' ''Lime'') is Billy's first known Pokémon. As an Eevee, Billy planned to [[Evolution|evolve]] him with a [[Thunder Stone]] during a circus performance, only for him to come into contact with a [[Fire Stone]], causing him to evolve into Flareon instead. Toril was taken by {{OBP|Harmony|JN098}} as she preferred {{t|Fire}} types, but Toril wouldn't listen to her commands and returned to Billy, where he was able to add to his performance with {{m|Ember}}. Working with Harmony's {{p|Jolteon}} and [[Chloe's Eevee]], Toril was able to put on a performance. He reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[JN105|Reuniting for the First Time!]]'' and ''[[JN120|Infinite Possibilities!]]''. In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Toril reappeared in a fantasy alongside Billy.
